title: 第15章 黛西修女第16章 越级杀怪
content_zh:
第十五章黛西修女(求票，求
“罗尔，现在我和菲尼斯的都需要你的帮助！”
“但为什么你不直接去告诉罗德斯城主！而且现在我们被困在这个地牢，根本出不去！”
此时郝宁内心却产生了一丝怀疑，为什么黛西修女的亡魂会在这！
黑暗使他看不清黛西修女的表情，他需要判断这个是不是已经挖好的陷阱，等待他这只猎物自动自觉地跳下去。
“我知道这里有后门，但我不能走出这座地牢，我已经死了，邪恶的力量搜索着我的行踪，所以我不能进入那道门，但是你够带着我离开这里！”
黛西修女冷若冰霜的语气似乎有了一些变化，郝宁从中听出了一丝愤怒，只见黛西修女另一只手也搭上了他的肩膀语重心长地说道。
“你的决定能够让整个菲尼斯得救！而你将获得城主的嘉奖，还有整个菲尼斯的敬仰与赞誉，你将成为一个救世主！”
让这个救世主的称号都见鬼去吧，这只是为了自己的性命，郝宁沉思了好一阵，才点头应道：“好，我们一起出去，但那道门在哪？”
这是郝宁能够逃出去唯一的方法，那就是跟黛西修女合作，因为只有她才知道能够逃出去的暗门在哪！
“你现在要做的就是放松，让我进入你的身体，这样才有可能避开黑暗中邪恶的走狗，我们才能进入那道暗门！”
忽然间黛西修女整个人抱住郝宁，轻声在他耳边说道：“放松，放松！这样做是为了我们两人，不会伤害你的，我答应你！”
在郝宁看不见的身后，黛西修女将她的手放在郝宁伤口上面，一股粉红色的力量从她手掌中蔓延出来，从郝宁的伤口缓缓渗透。
郝宁在黛西抱过来的时候真个人都愣住了，他感觉自己仿佛抱着一块巨大的冰块，他想立即推开黛西，但似乎有一股力量在阻止着他的动作。
顿时黛西修女化作一团粉红色雾气，消失在郝宁面前，过了好一阵子，他才从僵硬的状态恢复过来。
“黛西？你还在？”
郝宁狐疑地朝四周轻声呼唤，现在黛西是他唯一的指路明灯，虽然他还对她心存怀疑，但他并不能丢掉这一盏能救命的灯。
“我还在，我就在你的身体内！按照我的提示找到那道暗门，只有这样我们才能继续活下去！”
“不要点亮火焰，不要发出声音，往前走！”
忽然间黛西修女的声音直接在郝宁脑海中响起，一步步地提示着郝宁，如何在这个黑暗的空间内走动着。

此时郝宁感觉自己已经变成了一个盲人，看不清前方道路，但却要坚定往前走。这种感觉非常糟糕，未知的黑暗令人感到恐惧。
行走在黑暗中的郝宁走出了那间狭小的房子，重新回到了通道中，如果郝宁能够看见前方的道路，他就会发现自己正在一步步地往地牢最深处走去。
但是他现在什么都看不到！
另一边，黛西修女却进入了郝宁的精神世界，在她眼前是一个庞大而又充满机械感的房子。
一只只巴掌那么大的精灵手里捧着东西挥舞着翅膀在空中飞行，整个房间内都一片忙碌的样子。
每个人的精神世界都会不一样，因为每个人的内心与实力，这个精神世界也会发生改变。
但她从来没有见过这样的精神世界，这房子里面的东西就仿佛不是属于艾诺尔世界的东西一般。
就好比头上那些漂浮在空中的钢铁，她就根本不知道那是什么东西。
“欢迎来到联盟商店系统第99分部，你需要买什么东西呢？”忽然一只穿着职业装的小精灵飞到黛西的身边轻声问道。
“滚！”黛西修女猛然一巴掌将眼前的小精灵拍开，他来这里的目的不是来参观的。
她来到这里的目的完全是要摧毁郝宁的灵魂，占据他的身体，因为她要复活！
对于郝宁这个就连青铜阶实力都还没达到的人，黛西并未放在心上，因为他的精神世界并不会给黛西带来什么生命威胁，最多能够带来一些细小的麻烦而已。
“他一定还不能控制自己的精神世界，不然他现在也该发现我的入侵了，哼！”
黛西修女一步步地往房子深处走去，郝宁的灵魂极有可能就在精神世界的深处藏着。
忽然被打倒在地的小精灵爬了起来，揉揉疼痛的屁股，鼓起双腮大声喊道：“有人想打劫啊！打劫啊！有人想打劫咱们店啊！”
顿时其余忙碌的小精灵都停下了手中的动作，愣愣的看着地上的小精灵与黛西。
“啊！”刹那间全部小精灵齐声尖叫，仿佛无头苍蝇般四处逃散，不到一分钟全部小精灵瞬间消失不见，房间内只剩下地上那只小精灵与黛西修女。
“你们……你们这些胆小的家伙竟然抛弃了玛雅！警卫，有人打劫！呜呜呜！”
那只名字叫做玛雅的小精灵说着说着竟然嚎嚎大哭起来，泪水不断从她眼中涌出。
面对这样的情况黛西修女瞬间感到无比头疼，这个精神空间究竟是怎么一回事，这些奇怪的生物又是怎么一回事？

很快黛西就越过房子的大厅，进入了另一扇门！
当她跨过门的瞬间，眼前瞬间被五颜六色的光芒占据，她简直不敢相信自己的眼睛，在她眼前简直是一个比巨龙还富有的宝库。
堆积如山的黄金，还有那仿佛大白菜般随手扔在地上的黄金阶武器，黛西瞬间愣住了，她能够实实在在地感受到那些武器上的气息，这些东西简直跟真正的武器相差无异。
“这家伙究竟是什么人，能够在精神世界构建出这么多宝物，如果继续走下去，我很有可能有危险！”
但黛西修女却不知道这里这里是郝宁身体内的商店系统，一个拥有无数珍贵物品的神秘商店。
黛西脸色变得凝重，脚步停了下来不再往前走，她在犹豫，如果不趁着这个时候抢夺他的身体，以后就很难有机会可以复活。
虽然这具身体是男性，但对于黛西来说，没有什么比重获新生更加重要。
“汪汪汪！”
就在黛西修女犹豫要不要继续前进的时候，一只比普通家猫大不了多少的白色小狗挡在她面前，并且凶横地对着她狂吠，当然这份凶恶使它看上去更可爱。
“哼！一只绵羊不论内心有多强大，它都还是一只温顺的绵羊，这具身体我要定了！”
她一脚踢开那只白色小狗，正欲继续往商店深处走去，忽然间她眼前爆发出一阵铺天盖地的蓝色烈焰。
她定睛一看，那阵烈焰的源头竟然是刚刚被她踢开的小狗，火焰朝着黛西以不可阻挡的姿态蔓延，就连她身旁珍贵武器也遭受火焰的烧蚀。
炙热的火焰就连灵魂状态也感到害怕，仿佛稍微不慎就会魂飞魄散。
“糟了，碰上了一个硬骨头，圣光屏障！”黛西修女口中发出温和的吟唱声，一道圣洁光幕挡着她面前，暂时挡住了汹涌火焰，但看上去光幕似乎摇摇欲坠。
如果前一刻黛西还在犹豫，那么现在她已经忘却心中的犹豫，疯狂地向着进来时的入口奔去。
她已经挑了一个弱小的人类进行夺舍，但她想不到这次竟然踢到铁板上了。
火焰转眼间就冲破了屏障，火焰中那只小狗以闪电般的速度奔向黛西！
而那叫做玛雅的小精灵则在一边兴奋地叫着，不断地挥舞着一双小手给小狗打气！似乎对整个房间变成火海丝毫不在乎，仿佛烧坏的不是珍贵武器，而是一堆废纸。
“警卫！咬她，咬死这个可恶的女人！”
突然炙热的火焰已经燃上黛西的身体，将她身上的修女服烧毁了，露出里面白嫩的身躯。

“啊！”黛西修女忍不住发出一声惨叫，仅仅是火焰的贴近她的身体，她就感受到酷刑般的疼痛，她可以确定这火焰绝对不逊色于圣殿的火焰。
就快到了！黛西忍受着身上的疼痛向着纵身一跃，整个人在火焰的包围中化作一阵微光消散于空中。
玛雅小精灵满意地摸了摸小狗的脑袋说：“干得不错，警卫！如果下次有人来打劫，直接把他吃掉！”
“汪！”
于是很快这个联盟商店系统第99分部在这些精灵的管理下，再次恢复了秩序，仿佛已经遗忘刚刚那个闯进来的女人。
……………
郝宁依然在黑暗中摸索着，完全不知道自己的精神世界内发生了一件大事，而且那个黛西修女真正目的是抢夺他的身体。
“黛西修女，你在吗？”
他感到刚刚的一瞬间，黛西修女似乎消失了一般，无论他怎么呼唤都没有回应。
等待了好几分钟，黛西修女的声音才再次响起：“在，你继续走吧！按照我给你的提示，很快我们就能逃出去了！”
不知为何，郝宁似乎从黛西修女的声音中听出了一丝愤怒，他也没想太多，继续循着通道走去。
现在黛西修女可以说是赔了夫人又折兵，不仅没能夺过郝宁的身体，而且灵魂还受到了重伤。
嗒！一声水滴声在通道内响起，郝宁不由连忙停下了脚步，屏住呼吸，沉下心来双耳聆听着四周的动静。
“快跑！往前跑，那个黑暗的走狗从后面追上来了！”
忽然间郝宁心中响起了黛西焦急的声音，既然已经确定那个幽灵骑士就在身后，顿时他再也不淡定了，撒腿就往前面跑去。

Chapter 15 Sister Daisy (please vote, please
"Roel, both Phoenix and I need your help now!"
"But why don't you just go and tell Lord Rhodes! And now we are trapped in this dungeon and can't get out at all!"
At this time, Hao Ning had a suspicion in his heart, why is the ghost of Sister Daisy here?
The darkness prevented him from seeing Sister Daisy's expression clearly. He needed to judge whether this was a trap that had been dug, waiting for his prey to jump into it automatically.
"I know there is a back door here, but I can't get out of this dungeon. I'm already dead. The evil power is searching for my whereabouts, so I can't enter that door, but you can take me out of here!"
Sister Daisy's cold tone seemed to have changed. Hao Ning heard a hint of anger in it. Sister Daisy put her other hand on his shoulder and spoke earnestly.
"Your decision can save the entire Phoenix! And you will receive awards from the city lord, as well as the admiration and praise of the entire Phoenix. You will become a savior!"
To hell with the title of savior, this is just for his own life. Hao Ning thought for a while before nodding and responded: "Okay, let's go out together, but where is the door?"
This is the only way Hao Ning can escape, and that is to cooperate with Sister Daisy, because only she knows where the secret door to escape is!
"What you have to do now is relax and let me enter your body. Only in this way can we avoid the evil minions in the dark and we can enter the secret door!"
Suddenly, Sister Daisy hugged Hao Ning and whispered in his ear: "Relax, relax! This is for the two of us. It won't hurt you. I promise you!"
Behind Hao Ning's invisible side, Sister Daisy put her hand on Hao Ning's wound. A pink power spread from her palm and slowly penetrated from Hao Ning's wound.
Hao Ning was stunned when Daisy hugged her. He felt as if he was holding a huge ice cube. He wanted to push Daisy away immediately, but there seemed to be a force stopping his movement.
Suddenly, Sister Daisy turned into a ball of pink mist and disappeared in front of Hao Ning. It took a while for him to recover from his stiff state.
"Daisy? Are you still there?"
Hao Ning called around softly suspiciously. Now Daisy was his only guiding light. Although he still had doubts about her, he could not throw away this life-saving light.
"I'm still here, I'm in your body! Follow my prompts to find the secret door. Only in this way can we continue to live!"
"Don't light the fire, don't make the noise, move forward!"
Suddenly Sister Daisy's voice sounded directly in Hao Ning's mind, reminding Hao Ning step by step how to move around in this dark space.
At this time, Hao Ning felt that he had become a blind man and could not see the road ahead clearly, but he had to move forward firmly. This feeling is terrible, the unknown darkness is frightening.
Walking in the darkness, Hao Ning walked out of the small house and returned to the passage. If Hao Ning could see the road ahead, he would find that he was walking step by step towards the deepest part of the dungeon.
But he can't see anything now!
On the other side, Sister Daisy entered Hao Ning's spiritual world. In front of her was a huge and mechanical house.
An elf as big as a palm was holding something in its hand and flying in the air with its wings waving. The whole room looked busy.
Everyone's spiritual world will be different, and because of everyone's heart and strength, this spiritual world will also change.
But she had never seen such a spiritual world, and the things in this house seemed not to belong to the world of Ainol.
Just like those floating things above your headShe had no idea what the steel in the air was.
"Welcome to the 99th branch of the alliance store system. What do you need to buy?" Suddenly, an elf in professional attire flew to Daisy's side and asked softly.
"Get out!" Sister Daisy suddenly slapped the elf away in front of her. The purpose of his coming here was not to visit.
Her purpose of coming here is entirely to destroy Hao Ning's soul and occupy his body, because she wants to be resurrected!
Daisy didn't take Hao Ning seriously, because his spiritual world would not pose any threat to Daisy's life, and could only cause some minor troubles at most.
"He must not be able to control his spiritual world, otherwise he would have discovered my invasion by now, hum!"
Sister Daisy walked deeper into the house step by step. Hao Ning's soul was most likely hidden deep in the spiritual world.
Suddenly the elf who was knocked to the ground got up, rubbed his painful buttocks, puffed up his cheeks and shouted loudly: "Someone wants to rob! Robbery! Someone wants to rob our store!"
Suddenly, the other busy elves stopped what they were doing and looked blankly at the elf and Daisy on the ground.
"Ah!" In an instant, all the elves screamed in unison, running away like headless flies. In less than a minute, all the elves disappeared instantly, leaving only the elf on the ground and Sister Daisy in the room.
"You...you cowardly guys actually abandoned Maya! Guard, someone is robbing! Woohoo!"
The little elf named Maya started to howl and cry as she spoke, and tears kept pouring from her eyes.
Faced with this situation, Sister Daisy instantly felt a huge headache. What is going on in this spiritual space and what are these strange creatures?
Soon Daisy crossed the hall of the house and entered another door!
When she stepped through the door, her eyes were instantly occupied by colorful lights. She couldn't believe her eyes. In front of her was a treasure house richer than a giant dragon.
Daisy was stunned for a moment by the piles of gold and the gold-level weapons thrown on the ground like cabbage. She could actually feel the aura of those weapons. These things were almost the same as real weapons.
"Who is this guy? He can build so many treasures in the spiritual world. If I continue, I may be in danger!"
But Sister Daisy doesn't know that this is the store system in Hao Ning's body, a mysterious store with countless precious items.
Daisy's face became solemn, and she stopped walking forward. She was hesitating. If she didn't take advantage of this moment to snatch his body, it would be difficult to have a chance to resurrect him in the future.
Although the body is male, nothing is more important to Daisy than regaining her life.
"Woof woof woof!"
Just when Sister Daisy was hesitant to move forward, a white puppy, not much bigger than an ordinary house cat, stood in front of her and barked at her ferociously. Of course, this ferocity made it look even cuter.
"Hmph! No matter how strong a sheep's heart is, it is still a docile sheep. I want to fix this body!"
She kicked the white puppy away and was about to continue walking deeper into the store when suddenly a burst of overwhelming blue flames erupted in front of her eyes.
She took a closer look and saw that the source of the flames was the puppy she had just kicked away. The flames spread unstoppably towards Daisy, and even the precious weapons beside her were eroded by the flames.
Even the state of the soul is frightened by the scorching flames, as if the soul will fly away if it is not careful.
"Oops, we hit a hard nut, the Holy Light Barrier!" Sister Daisy let out a gentle chant, and a ray of holy light came out of her mouth.The curtain stood in front of her, temporarily blocking the raging flames, but it looked like the light curtain was crumbling.
If Daisy was still hesitating a moment ago, now she had forgotten the hesitation in her heart and ran frantically towards the entrance.
She had already picked a weak human to fight for his body, but she didn't expect that this time he would be kicked onto the iron plate.
The flames broke through the barrier in an instant, and the puppy in the flames ran towards Daisy at lightning speed!
And the elf named Maya was shouting excitedly on the side, constantly waving her little hands to cheer up the puppy! He didn't seem to care that the whole room turned into a sea of ​​flames, as if what was burned was not a precious weapon but a pile of waste paper.
"Guard! Bite her, bite this hateful woman to death!"
Suddenly, the hot flames burned Daisy's body, burning the nun's uniform on her body, revealing her white and tender body underneath.
"Ah!" Sister Daisy couldn't help but let out a scream. Just because the flame was close to her body, she felt torture-like pain. She was sure that this flame was definitely not inferior to the flame of the temple.
Almost there! Daisy endured the pain on her body and jumped forward, her whole body turned into a burst of light and dissipated in the air surrounded by flames.
The Mayan elf patted the puppy's head with satisfaction and said, "Well done, guard! If someone comes to rob next time, just eat him!"
"Woof!"
So soon, under the management of these elves, the 99th branch of the alliance store system restored order again, as if the woman who just broke in had been forgotten.
……………
Hao Ning was still groping in the darkness, completely unaware that a major event had happened in his spiritual world, and that Sister Daisy's real purpose was to rob his body.
"Sister Daisy, are you there?"
He felt that Sister Daisy seemed to have disappeared in that moment, and there was no response no matter how he called.
After waiting for several minutes, Sister Daisy's voice sounded again: "Here, keep walking! Follow the tips I gave you, and we will be able to escape soon!"
For some reason, Hao Ning seemed to hear a hint of anger in Sister Daisy's voice. He didn't think too much and continued walking along the passage.
Now Sister Daisy can be said to have lost her wife and lost her troops. Not only did she fail to take Hao Ning's body, but her soul was also seriously injured.
despair! The sound of water droplets sounded in the passage, and Hao Ning couldn't help but stop quickly, held his breath, calmed down and listened to the movement around him.
"Run! Run forward, that dark lackey is catching up from behind!"
Suddenly Daisy's anxious voice sounded in Hao Ning's heart. Now that he was sure that the Ghost Rider was behind him, he suddenly lost his composure and ran forward.
